name: Upper Peninsula
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) is the only realistic window for most visitors, with the mildest weather and Mackinac Island in full swing; winters are brutally cold with some of the heaviest lake-effect snowfall in the country.
overview: Pictured Rocks' colorful cliffs on Lake Superior, car-free Mackinac Island, and genuine aurora-viewing potential — one of the most remote, least-crowded corners of the American Midwest.
costOverview: Genuinely one of the more affordable US destinations on this list — pasties, fudge, and boat tours all stay reasonable, and there's no real luxury tier to speak of.
